concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-control-panel-transactions-declines]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree transaction-decline snapshot distinguishing issuer processor declines, gateway-setting rejections and network-unavailable responses, with authorization/settlement timing, response-specific hard/soft handling, and Visa/Mastercard-qualified retry limits and fees; includes unresolved internal Visa retry conflicts and is not current network-rule, account-eligibility, configuration or execution evidence
warnings: The raw Visa table places response code 2007 in both Category 1 and Category 3 with conflicting retry instructions, and the 2044 implication conflicts with its Category 1 do-not-retry label; do not normalize these into a single permission.
